decisions.decision: SUPERSEDES the two AWS-provisioning decisions below: Attic runs on ohio1, the EXISTING Deocracy production server (EC2 i-0f67d53f073662a52, t4g.large aarch64, us-east-2, NixOS, flake repo Deocracy/nixos-hosting, self-deploys from main every 30 min). No new EC2/IAM/keypair. cache.deocracy.org rides the existing Cloudflare tunnel (wp-ohio1) as a new ingress entry - no A record, no ACME. Storage: executor decides local-disk vs S3 after checking box disk headroom and the existing S3 backup role; GC retention nonzero either way. Scale-out to a dedicated cache instance is the Phase 11 review point, recorded in the runbook.
decisions.rationale: Server is already AWS + NixOS + flake-managed ('not that active' per user); adding a second instance in the same account buys no isolation; $0 extra; 'we can always add more servers when we need to'. Full server facts: /home/chris/infra/nixos-hosting/docs/DECISIONS.md STATE section + that project's memory.
